s: 他喝了一杯午奶就出门了。
s_py: tā hē le yī bēi wǔ nǎi jiù chū mén le
zh: 他喝了一杯牛奶就出门了。
py: tā hē le yī bēi niú nǎi jiù chū mén le
en: He drank a glass of milk and went out.
why: Milk is 牛奶, from the ox 牛, whose stroke pokes through the top line like a horn. 午 stops at the line and is in 下午 and 午饭, so 午奶 is wrong.

q: 出发的时___，天还没有亮。
zh: 出发的时候，天还没有亮。
py: chū fā de shí hou tiān hái méi yǒu liàng
en: When we set off, it was still dark.
why: 时候 'time' ends in 候 hòu: 亻, then a short vertical, then 矢. 侯 hóu lacks that vertical and is a surname, so 时侯 is wrong. Waiting (候) has a stroke more.

q: 孩子们高兴___唱起了歌。
zh: 孩子们高兴地唱起了歌。
py: hái zi men gāo xìng de chàng qǐ le gē
en: The children began to sing happily.
why: Between a word describing the way and a verb, the particle is 地 (de), the same character as 'ground'. 池 (pool) and 他 (he) cannot link 高兴 to 唱起了歌.

q: 我想___一下，这趟火车几点到？
zh: 我想问一下，这趟火车几点到？
py: wǒ xiǎng wèn yī xià zhè tàng huǒ chē jǐ diǎn dào
en: I'd like to ask what time this train arrives.
why: 'Ask' is 问 wèn, with a mouth 口 inside the door. 间 (sun inside) is a room or time and 闻 (ear) is news or smell; neither is the verb you use to ask.

q: 跑了一个小时，我又累又___。
zh: 跑了一个小时，我又累又渴。
py: pǎo le yī gè xiǎo shí wǒ yòu lèi yòu kě
en: After running for an hour, I was tired and thirsty.
why: 'Thirsty' is a feeling and takes water 氵: 渴 kě. 喝 hē (drink) has a mouth and is an action; 又累又喝 does not work, because 又…又… pairs two states.

q: 你看，___就是我们的新家。
zh: 你看，那就是我们的新家。
py: nǐ kàn nà jiù shì wǒ men de xīn jiā
en: Look, that's our new home.
why: The speaker is pointing: 那 nà, 'that', has no mouth. 哪 asks a question, and 哪就是 does not work as a statement. Pointing needs no mouth; asking does.

q: 我家有一只小猫，___很喜欢睡觉。
zh: 我家有一只小猫，它很喜欢睡觉。
py: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī xiǎo māo tā hěn xǐ huan shuì jiào
en: We have a little cat at home; it loves sleeping.
why: A cat is an animal, so it is 它 (the 宀 roof, for animals and things). 他 is a man and 她 a woman, and both would personify the cat; plain writing uses 它.

s: 你在找什么？
s_py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me
zh: 你在找什么？
py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me
en: What are you looking for?
why: Correct. 找 zhǎo, 'look for', has no slant on top. 我 wǒ is 'I'. Do not mark this wrong because 我 looks more familiar.

q: 医生说，我们每天都要锻___半个小时。
zh: 医生说，我们每天都要锻炼半个小时。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ men měi tiān dōu yào duàn liàn bàn ge xiǎo shí
en: The doctor says we should work out for half an hour every day.
why: 锻炼 'work out' comes from forging metal, so 炼 has fire 火. 练 has silk 纟 and is for 练习, practising a skill; 锻练 is a common typo.

q: 我___爸爸一起去看了一场电影。
zh: 我跟爸爸一起去看了一场电影。
py: wǒ gēn bà ba yī qǐ qù kàn le yī chǎng diàn yǐng
en: I went to see a film with my dad.
why: 'With' is 跟 gēn, with a foot 足: you go along with someone. 根 (wood) is a root, 很 (step 彳) 'very', and 狠 (animal 犭) 'fierce'. Only 跟 fits before 爸爸一起.

s: 今天是晴天，我们去海边玩吧。
s_py: jīn tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù hǎi biān wán ba
zh: 今天是晴天，我们去海边玩吧。
py: jīn tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù hǎi biān wán ba
en: It's sunny today; let's go to the seaside.
why: Correct. 晴天 'sunny day' has 日, the sun, and is written 晴. Do not change it to 情 or 清 just because they sound the same.

q: 明天是___天，我们去公园玩吧。
zh: 明天是晴天，我们去公园玩吧。
py: míng tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù gōng yuán wán ba
en: Tomorrow will be sunny; let's go to the park.
why: Weather is about the sun, so 晴天 'sunny day' has 日: 晴 qíng. 情 (heart) is feeling and 清 (water) is clear; 情天 and 清天 do not mean sunny day.

q: 爸爸带我们去游泳___游泳。
zh: 爸爸带我们去游泳池游泳。
py: bà ba dài wǒ men qù yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng
en: Dad took us to the pool to swim.
why: A swimming pool is 游泳池: 池 chí has water 氵. 地 has earth 土 (ground), and 游泳地 is not a place to swim; where there is water, there is 氵.

q: 他每天练习钢琴，非常努___。
zh: 他每天练习钢琴，非常努力。
py: tā měi tiān liàn xí gāng qín fēi cháng nǔ lì
en: He practises the piano every day and works very hard.
why: 努力 'work hard' ends in 力 lì, whose top stroke pokes up past the line. 刀 dāo (knife) does not poke out. 努刀 is not a word; 力 is strength.

q: 妈妈用一把___切蛋糕。
zh: 妈妈用一把刀切蛋糕。
py: mā ma yòng yī bǎ dāo qiē dàn gāo
en: Mum cut the cake with a knife.
why: You cut with a knife: 刀 dāo, whose top stroke stays inside the line. 力 pokes out above it and means strength; 一把力 is not a thing you cut with.

q: 我___你看电影，好不好？
zh: 我请你看电影，好不好？
py: wǒ qǐng nǐ kàn diàn yǐng hǎo bu hǎo
en: I'll treat you to a film, okay?
why: 'Invite, treat' is 请 qǐng, with speech 讠, since you ask someone with words. 清, 情, 晴 have water, heart, sun and cannot take 你 as an object this way.

q: 孩子们___点就上床睡觉了。
zh: 孩子们八点就上床睡觉了。
py: hái zi men bā diǎn jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào le
en: The children went to bed at eight o'clock.
why: The clock time is 八点: 八 bā, two strokes that do not touch. 人 and 入 touch at the top, and 人点 and 入点 are not times.

q: 关___这部电影，我知道得不多。
zh: 关于这部电影，我知道得不多。
py: guān yú zhè bù diàn yǐng wǒ zhī dào de bù duō
en: I don't know much about this film.
why: 关于 'about, regarding' is 于 with the final hook (yú). 千 and 干 have no hook, and 关千 / 关干 are not words. Remember: 于 hooks onto its topic.

q: 爷爷每天散步，所以身___很好。
zh: 爷爷每天散步，所以身体很好。
py: yé ye měi tiān sàn bù suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
en: Grandpa walks every day, so he is in good health.
why: 'Body, health' is 身体: 体 tǐ has 本 (an extra line). 休 has 木 and means rest. 身休 would be a rest of the body, not health. 本 has the extra line, for the body.

q: 我们下___三点在车站见面。
zh: 我们下午三点在车站见面。
py: wǒ men xià wǔ sān diǎn zài chē zhàn jiàn miàn
en: We'll meet at the station at three in the afternoon.
why: 下午 is 午 wǔ, whose vertical stroke stops at the top line. 牛 niú has a stroke that pokes through the top line like a horn: that is the ox, as in 牛奶. 下牛 is not a word.

q: 我___了好几次电话，朋友都没有接。
zh: 我拨了好几次电话，朋友都没有接。
py: wǒ bō le hǎo jǐ cì diàn huà péng you dōu méi yǒu jiē
en: I dialled several times, but my friend never answered.
why: 'Dial' is 拨 bō, with 发 on the right (发出, send out a call). 拔 bá has 犮 and means pull out, as in 拔牙, so 拔电话 is wrong.

q: 这本小说___好看了，我一晚上就看完了。
zh: 这本小说太好看了，我一晚上就看完了。
py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō tài hǎo kàn le wǒ yī wǎn shàng jiù kàn wán le
en: This novel is so good that I finished it in one evening.
why: 太……了 expresses 'so, too much', and 太 tài is 大 with a dot below. 大好看了 is not Chinese, and 夫 means husband; the dot makes the degree word.

q: 昨天的音乐会太___彩了！
zh: 昨天的音乐会太精彩了！
py: zuó tiān de yīn yuè huì tài jīng cǎi le
en: Yesterday's concert was brilliant!
why: 精彩 'brilliant' is written with 精 jīng, with rice 米 (essence, refined). 睛 has the eye radical and is only in 眼睛; 睛彩 and 晴彩 are not words.

q: 你最喜欢___首歌？是第一首还是第二首？
zh: 你最喜欢哪首歌？是第一首还是第二首？
py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ shǒu gē shì dì yī shǒu hái shì dì èr shǒu
en: Which song do you like best, the first or the second?
why: The follow-up 'the first or the second?' shows this is a 'which' question, so 哪 nǎ with the mouth 口. 那 would be 'that song', a statement of fact with no choice.

s: 她的丈夫很喜欢看电影。
s_py: tā de zhàng fu hěn xǐ huan kàn diàn yǐng
zh: 她的丈夫很喜欢看电影。
py: tā de zhàng fu hěn xǐ huan kàn diàn yǐng
en: Her husband likes watching films a lot.
why: Correct. 丈夫 'husband' ends in 夫, with the slant poking out above both lines. 大 and 天 do not form this word.

q: 这个周___我们去听音乐会。
zh: 这个周末我们去听音乐会。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men qù tīng yīn yuè huì
en: We're going to a concert this weekend.
why: 周末 is the end of the week, and 末 has the long line on top, the marked tip of a tree. 未 (short top line) means 'not yet' and gives 未来, so 周未 is wrong.

q: 请问，音乐厅在___儿？
zh: 请问，音乐厅在哪儿？
py: qǐng wèn yīn yuè tīng zài nǎ r
en: Excuse me, where is the concert hall?
why: A 'where' question needs 哪 nǎ, which is 那 with an asking mouth 口. 那儿 means 'there', so 在那儿 would be an answer, not a question.

s: 我听不请楚，请你再说一遍。
s_py: wǒ tīng bù qǐng chu qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
zh: 我听不清楚，请你再说一遍。
py: wǒ tīng bù qīng chu qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
en: I can't hear clearly; please say it again.
why: Wrong: 清楚 'clear' takes the water radical 氵 (clear water), not the speech 讠. The second 请 in 请你 is right, since asking is speech.

q: 我想去书店___一本新小说，送给朋友当礼物。
zh: 我想去书店买一本新小说，送给朋友当礼物。
py: wǒ xiǎng qù shū diàn mǎi yī běn xīn xiǎo shuō sòng gěi péng you dāng lǐ wù
en: I want to buy a new novel at the bookstore as a present for my friend.
why: You get a book to give as a present, so it is 买 mǎi, buy, with no extra stroke on top. 卖 mài (sell) has 十 on top: 多了就卖，少了就买.

s: 他把旧书都买了，换了一点钱。
s_py: tā bǎ jiù shū dōu mǎi le huàn le yī diǎn qián
zh: 他把旧书都卖了，换了一点钱。
py: tā bǎ jiù shū dōu mài le huàn le yī diǎn qián
en: He sold all his old books and got a bit of money for them.
why: Wrong: getting money for old books is selling, 卖 mài, with 十 on top. 买 is buying, so it cannot give you money. More on top sells.

q: 爷爷的生___在秋天。
zh: 爷爷的生日在秋天。
py: yé ye de shēng rì zài qiū tiān
en: Grandpa's birthday is in autumn.
why: 生日 'birthday' is 日 rì, the sun, with one line inside. 目 (eye) is taller with two lines inside, and 白 has a dot on top. 生目 and 生白 are not words.

s: 这个周末我想在家看书。
s_py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kàn shū
zh: 这个周末我想在家看书。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kàn shū
en: This weekend I want to stay home and read.
why: Correct. 周末 has the long line on top (末, the end of the week). 未 with the short top line means 'not yet'.

q: ___问，去火车站怎么走？
zh: 请问，去火车站怎么走？
py: qǐng wèn qù huǒ chē zhàn zěn me zǒu
en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
why: 请问 is 'may I ask', a polite request made with words: 请 has the speech radical 讠. 清 (water) and 情 (heart) do not make 清问 or 情问.

q: 她的丈___在一家旅行社工作。
zh: 她的丈夫在一家旅行社工作。
py: tā de zhàng fu zài yī jiā lǚ xíng shè gōng zuò
en: Her husband works at a travel agency.
why: 丈夫 'husband' ends in 夫 fū: two lines, with the slant poking out above both. 丈天 and 丈大 are not words. Think of 夫 as a grown-up (大) with a hairpin through his hair.

q: 他___然忘了朋友的生日。
zh: 他竟然忘了朋友的生日。
py: tā jìng rán wàng le péng you de shēng rì
en: He actually forgot his friend's birthday.
why: 竟然 'unexpectedly' has 音 over 儿: 竟 jìng. 竞 has 立 over 兄 and is for 竞争 'compete'; 竞然 is the typo. 竟 has 日, the sound-sun, in the middle.

q: 这部电影的___要演员我都认识。
zh: 这部电影的主要演员我都认识。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng de zhǔ yào yǎn yuán wǒ dōu rèn shi
en: I know the main actors of this film.
why: 主要 'main' is 主 zhǔ on its own, the base character with no radical. 住要 and 注要 do not exist. 主 is the lamp's flame on a stand: the main thing.

q: 开车的时候要___意看路。
zh: 开车的时候要注意看路。
py: kāi chē de shí hou yào zhù yì kàn lù
en: You must pay attention to the road when you drive.
why: 注意 'pay attention' has 氵 water: attention is poured onto something. 住意 and 往意 are not words, although 住 sounds just like 注. Sound won't help; the radical does.

q: 为了参加音乐会，她每天都___习钢琴。
zh: 为了参加音乐会，她每天都练习钢琴。
py: wèi le cān jiā yīn yuè huì tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí gāng qín
en: To get ready for the concert, she practises piano every day.
why: 练习 'practise' has silk 纟: skills are woven by repetition. 炼 (fire) is for 锻炼 and 炼铁. 炼习 is a mix-up of the two words.

s: 妈妈在柜子里我她的旧照片。
s_py: mā ma zài guì zi lǐ wǒ tā de jiù zhào piàn
zh: 妈妈在柜子里找她的旧照片。
py: mā ma zài guì zi lǐ zhǎo tā de jiù zhào piàn
en: Mum is looking through the cupboard for her old photos.
why: Wrong: the verb 'look for' is 找. 我 is 'I' and cannot be the verb here; 找 is just 我 without the top slant.

q: 请给我一双___子。
zh: 请给我一双筷子。
py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī shuāng kuài zi
en: Please give me a pair of chopsticks.
why: Chopsticks are 筷子, and 筷 kuài has bamboo 竹 on top. 快 (heart) is fast and 块 (earth) a lump or yuan; 快子 and 块子 are not words. Chopsticks used to be made of bamboo.

q: 看到这封信，她的眼___一下子流了下来。
zh: 看到这封信，她的眼泪一下子流了下来。
py: kàn dào zhè fēng xìn tā de yǎn lèi yī xià zi liú le xià lái
en: On reading this letter, her tears suddenly started to fall.
why: Tears are water from the eye, so 泪 lèi has 氵 beside 目. 汨 has 日 (sun), is a rare river name, and has no use for 眼. Eye 目 = tears.

q: 奶奶把房间打扫得很___净。
zh: 奶奶把房间打扫得很干净。
py: nǎi nai bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de hěn gān jìng
en: Grandma cleaned the room until it was spotless.
why: 干净 'clean' starts with 干 gān: two flat lines and a straight stroke. 千 begins with a slanted stroke (thousand) and 于 has a hook at the end; neither makes 千净 or 于净.

q: 听到这首歌，我的心___一下子变好了。
zh: 听到这首歌，我的心情一下子变好了。
py: tīng dào zhè shǒu gē wǒ de xīn qíng yī xià zi biàn hǎo le
en: Hearing this song instantly lifted my mood.
why: 心情 'mood' is about the heart, so it takes 忄: 情 qíng. 晴 (sun) is weather and 清 (water) is clear; neither is a feeling.

s: 她把头发扎成了一条长长的辨子。
s_py: tā bǎ tóu fa zā chéng le yī tiáo cháng cháng de biàn zi
zh: 她把头发扎成了一条长长的辫子。
py: tā bǎ tóu fa zā chéng le yī tiáo cháng cháng de biàn zi
en: She tied her hair into a long plait.
why: Wrong: a plait is 辫子, with silk 纟 (hair braided like thread). 辨 has a knife-like slash in the middle and is in 分辨, tell apart.

s: 爸爸说开车的时候不能喝洒。
s_py: bà ba shuō kāi chē de shí hou bù néng hē sǎ
zh: 爸爸说开车的时候不能喝酒。
py: bà ba shuō kāi chē de shí hou bù néng hē jiǔ
en: Dad says you can't drink alcohol when you drive.
why: Wrong: alcohol is 酒, with 酉 (a jar with an extra line inside). 洒 sǎ means sprinkle and has only 西; you cannot 喝 something sprinkled.

q: 春节放假，爸爸可以在家好好___息几天。
zh: 春节放假，爸爸可以在家好好休息几天。
py: chūn jié fàng jià bà ba kě yǐ zài jiā hǎo hǎo xiū xi jǐ tiān
en: During the Spring Festival, Dad can rest at home for a few days.
why: 'Rest' is 休息: 休 is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木. 体 has 本, with an extra line, and means body; 体息 is a classic typo.

q: 这部电影真___人难忘。
zh: 这部电影真令人难忘。
py: zhè bù diàn yǐng zhēn lìng rén nán wàng
en: This film is truly unforgettable.
why: 令人 'makes people feel' uses 令 lìng, with 卩 at the bottom. 今 jīn (今天) ends in a 7-like stroke. 今人 would mean 'people today', which does not fit 难忘.

q: 今___是我妈妈的生日。
zh: 今天是我妈妈的生日。
py: jīn tiān shì wǒ mā ma de shēng rì
en: Today is my mum's birthday.
why: 今天 'today' is 天 tiān: 大 with a line on top, like the sky over a person. 太 has a dot below and is for 'too' (太好了); 今太 is not a word.

q: 我不知道方___，只好问路。
zh: 我不知道方向，只好问路。
py: wǒ bù zhī dào fāng xiàng zhǐ hǎo wèn lù
en: I don't know the direction, so I had to ask the way.
why: 'Direction' is 方向: 向 xiàng is a house with a window, facing toward something. 方像 and 方象 are not words, although 像 and 象 sound the same.

q: 这道题___很难，我看了三遍。
zh: 这道题目很难，我看了三遍。
py: zhè dào tí mù hěn nán wǒ kàn le sān biàn
en: This question is hard; I read it three times.
why: 题目 'question, topic' ends in 目 mù, the eye, two lines inside and taller. 日 is the sun with one line (生日). 题日 and 题自 are not words.

q: 去哪儿旅行，爸爸还没有拿定___意。
zh: 去哪儿旅行，爸爸还没有拿定主意。
py: qù nǎ r lǚ xíng bà ba hái méi yǒu ná dìng zhǔ yi
en: Dad still hasn't made up his mind where to travel.
why: 拿定主意 'make up one's mind' has 主 zhǔ, the master of the decision. 注意 (zhù yì) is 'pay attention' and cannot be 'made up'; 住意 is not a word.

q: 他长得很___爸爸，连说话也一样。
zh: 他长得很像爸爸，连说话也一样。
py: tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng bà ba lián shuō huà yě yī yàng
en: He looks a lot like his dad, and even talks the same way.
why: 'Look like' is 像 xiàng, with a person 亻. 象 is the elephant, and 向 means toward and takes a direction, not a person to resemble. A person is like a person: 亻.

q: 老师说得很___楚，我都听懂了。
zh: 老师说得很清楚，我都听懂了。
py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
en: The teacher explained it very clearly; I understood it all.
why: 清楚 'clear' has the water radical 氵: clear water. 请楚 and 情楚 are not words. Clear water, clear meaning.

q: 现在是七点___，电影马上开始了。
zh: 现在是七点半，电影马上开始了。
py: xiàn zài shì qī diǎn bàn diàn yǐng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ le
en: It's half past seven; the film is about to start.
why: 'Half past' is 半 bàn, with two dots on top of 二 and 十. 牛 niú has just one slanted stroke on top and means ox; 七点牛 is not a time.

q: 听了老师的解释，我才明___这首歌的意思。
zh: 听了老师的解释，我才明白这首歌的意思。
py: tīng le lǎo shī de jiě shì wǒ cái míng bai zhè shǒu gē de yì si
en: After the teacher's explanation I finally understood what the song means.
why: 明白 'understand, clear' ends in 白: 日 with a dot on top, the first light of day. 明日 means 'tomorrow' (literary) and 明目 'bright-eyed'; neither can take an object like 这首歌的意思.

q: ___面下雪了，多穿点儿衣服吧。
zh: 外面下雪了，多穿点儿衣服吧。
py: wài miàn xià xuě le duō chuān diǎn r yī fu ba
en: It's snowing outside; wear more clothes.
why: 'Outside' is 外面: 外 wài starts with 夕 and ends in 卜. 处 chù starts with 夂, whose long sweep runs under 卜, and is in 好处; 处面 is not a word.

q: 朋友来了，爸爸拿出了一瓶___。
zh: 朋友来了，爸爸拿出了一瓶酒。
py: péng you lái le bà ba ná chū le yī píng jiǔ
en: A friend came, so Dad took out a bottle of wine.
why: A bottle of alcohol is 酒 jiǔ: 氵 beside 酉, the jar. 洒 sǎ has only 西 and means to spill or sprinkle, which does not come in a bottle.

s: 她的眼晴红红的，好像刚哭过。
s_py: tā de yǎn qíng hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng gāng kū guo
zh: 她的眼睛红红的，好像刚哭过。
py: tā de yǎn jing hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng gāng kū guo
en: Her eyes were red, as if she had just been crying.
why: Wrong: eyes are 眼睛, with the eye radical 目. 晴 has the sun 日 and means sunny. Eyes see (目); the sun shines (日).

q: 一直___前走，到了红绿灯就右拐。
zh: 一直往前走，到了红绿灯就右拐。
py: yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu dào le hóng lǜ dēng jiù yòu guǎi
en: Go straight ahead and turn right at the traffic light.
why: 'Toward' is 往 wǎng, with the step radical 彳 (two slanted strokes), because steps go somewhere. 住 has a single slanted stroke 亻 and means live; 注 has water.

q: 我___经看完那本书了。
zh: 我已经看完那本书了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng kàn wán nà běn shū le
en: I've already finished that book.
why: 已经 means 'already' and is written with 已, whose left stroke rises only halfway. 己 (open, as in 自己) is 'self'; 巳 is fully closed and not used here. Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half, 巳 full.

q: 朋友要去上海了，我们下个月再___。
zh: 朋友要去上海了，我们下个月再见。
py: péng you yào qù shàng hǎi le wǒ men xià ge yuè zài jiàn
en: My friend is going to Shanghai; we'll see each other next month.
why: 再见 'see you again' ends in 见 jiàn, a leg with a hooked foot (also 'see'). 贝 bèi ends in a dot and means shell, as in 宝贝; 再贝 is not a word.

s: 音乐厅的人口在后门，请从这里进去。
s_py: yīn yuè tīng de rén kǒu zài hòu mén qǐng cóng zhè lǐ jìn qù
zh: 音乐厅的入口在后门，请从这里进去。
py: yīn yuè tīng de rù kǒu zài hòu mén qǐng cóng zhè lǐ jìn qù
en: The entrance of the concert hall is at the back door; please go in here.
why: Wrong: a place you 'go in' is 入口, an entrance, written with 入 (long right stroke). 人口 means 'population'.

q: 他们的爱___故事被拍成了电影。
zh: 他们的爱情故事被拍成了电影。
py: tā men de ài qíng gù shi bèi pāi chéng le diàn yǐng
en: Their love story was made into a film.
why: 爱情 'romantic love' is about the heart, so 情 has 忄. 请 (speech) and 清 (water) give 爱请 and 爱清, which mean nothing. Feelings are always 忄.

q: 树上有两只小___在唱歌。
zh: 树上有两只小鸟在唱歌。
py: shù shàng yǒu liǎng zhī xiǎo niǎo zài chàng gē
en: Two little birds are singing in the tree.
why: Singing little birds are 鸟 niǎo, with a dot for the eye. 乌 wū (crow) has no eye dot, because a black crow's eye cannot be seen, so it belongs in 乌云 'dark clouds'.

q: 周末我想___朋友一起去爬山。
zh: 周末我想找朋友一起去爬山。
py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zhǎo péng you yī qǐ qù pá shān
en: At the weekend I want to get my friends together to go hiking.
why: After 我想 comes a verb: 找 'look up, call on' fits 找朋友. 我 is a pronoun and cannot follow 我想 as 我想我朋友一起去. 找 is just 我 without the top slant.

q: 周末我们去体育馆打___球。
zh: 周末我们去体育馆打篮球。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
en: At the weekend we're going to the gym to play basketball.
why: Basketball is 篮球: 篮 lán has bamboo 竹 (a basket is woven from it). 蓝 has grass 艹 and means blue, and 蓝球 would be a 'blue ball'.

q: 我家___在一条安静的小街上。
zh: 我家住在一条安静的小街上。
py: wǒ jiā zhù zài yī tiáo ān jìng de xiǎo jiē shàng
en: My home is on a quiet little street.
why: 'Live (at)' is 住 zhù, a person 亻 beside 主: a person lives somewhere. 往 (steps) means 'toward' and 注 (water) is 'pour', so 往在 and 注在 do not work.

s: 他们在辩论哪个电影更好看。
s_py: tā men zài biàn lùn nǎ ge diàn yǐng gèng hǎo kàn
zh: 他们在辩论哪个电影更好看。
py: tā men zài biàn lùn nǎ ge diàn yǐng gèng hǎo kàn
en: They are debating which film is better.
why: Correct. 辩论 'debate' has speech 讠 in the middle: debating is done with words. 辨 (tell apart) has no speech radical.

q: 她对___来很有信心。
zh: 她对未来很有信心。
py: tā duì wèi lái hěn yǒu xìn xīn
en: She is very confident about the future.
why: 未来 'future' is written 未 wèi, 'not yet', with the long line at the bottom. 末 (long line on top, the tip of the tree) means 'end' and sits in 周末; 末来 is not a word.

q: 看，那边的___云越来越多，我们快回家吧。
zh: 看，那边的乌云越来越多，我们快回家吧。
py: kàn nà biān de wū yún yuè lái yuè duō wǒ men kuài huí jiā ba
en: Look, more and more dark clouds are gathering over there; let's get home quickly.
why: Dark clouds are 乌云: 乌 wū has no eye dot, like a black crow. 鸟云 would be 'bird clouds'; 鸟 has the dot and means bird.

s: 我妈妈跟她朋友去看电影了。
s_py: wǒ mā ma gēn tā péng you qù kàn diàn yǐng le
zh: 我妈妈跟她朋友去看电影了。
py: wǒ mā ma gēn tā péng you qù kàn diàn yǐng le
en: My mum has gone to the cinema with her friend.
why: Correct. 跟 gēn 'with' has a foot 足; 她 is right for a woman. 根 (wood) is a root and 很 'very', so neither fits.

q: 我姐姐是医院的护___。
zh: 我姐姐是医院的护士。
py: wǒ jiě jie shì yī yuàn de hù shi
en: My older sister is a nurse at the hospital.
why: 护士 'nurse' ends in 士, whose top line is the long one. 土 (earth) has the long line at the bottom, as in 土豆; 护土 is not a word. Picture: 士 stands tall, the ground 土 lies wide.

q: 这张音乐会的票要一___块钱。
zh: 这张音乐会的票要一千块钱。
py: zhè zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào yào yī qiān kuài qián
en: This concert ticket costs a thousand yuan.
why: 'A thousand' is 一千: 千 qiān starts with a slanted stroke over the 十. 干 has flat lines on top and 于 ends in a hook, so 一干 and 一于 cannot be a number.

q: 等了很久，火车终___到了。
zh: 等了很久，火车终于到了。
py: děng le hěn jiǔ huǒ chē zhōng yú dào le
en: After a long wait, the train finally arrived.
why: 终于 'finally' ends in 于 yú, which has a hook at the bottom. 干 is straight, with no hook, and is the gān of 干净; 终干 is not a word.

q: 祝你生日快___！
zh: 祝你生日快乐！
py: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
en: Happy birthday!
why: 'Happy' is 快乐: 乐 lè starts with a slanted stroke and has two small feet. 东 dōng starts with a flat line, and 车 has no feet; 快东 and 快车 do not express a greeting.

q: 他喜欢自___一个人听音乐。
zh: 他喜欢自己一个人听音乐。
py: tā xǐ huan zì jǐ yī ge rén tīng yīn yuè
en: He likes to listen to music by himself.
why: 自己 'oneself' ends in 己, the fully open one. 已 (half closed) belongs to 已经, 'already', and 自已 is not a word. Remember: 己 is wide open, like a person with arms out.

q: 我们城市的___口有一千万。
zh: 我们城市的人口有一千万。
py: wǒ men chéng shì de rén kǒu yǒu yī qiān wàn
en: Our city has a population of ten million.
why: 'Population' is 人口: 人 rén leans on its long left stroke. 入口 (long right stroke) is an entrance, and an entrance cannot number ten million. Remember: 人 is a person walking left, 入 goes in to the right.

s: 我目己一个人去看了这部电影。
s_py: wǒ mù jǐ yī ge rén qù kàn le zhè bù diàn yǐng
zh: 我自己一个人去看了这部电影。
py: wǒ zì jǐ yī ge rén qù kàn le zhè bù diàn yǐng
en: I went to see this film all by myself.
why: 'By myself' is 自己; 自 is 目 with a dot on top. 目己 is not a word: 目 mù is the eye and has no dot.

q: 我姐姐很喜欢唱歌，___每个周末都去练习。
zh: 我姐姐很喜欢唱歌，她每个周末都去练习。
py: wǒ jiě jie hěn xǐ huan chàng gē tā měi ge zhōu mò dōu qù liàn xí
en: My older sister loves singing; she goes to practise every weekend.
why: A sister is a woman, so it is 她, with 女. 他 is for a man and 它 for animals and things; both sound tā, so only the meaning decides.

q: 我们必___带够水。
zh: 我们必须带够水。
py: wǒ men bì xū dài gòu shuǐ
en: We must bring enough water.
why: 'Must' before a verb is 必须: 须 has 彡 (hair) and 页 (head). 需 (rain 雨 on top) is 需要, 'need', and 必需 is 'essential', used mainly as 必需品, so it cannot come before 带.

q: 妈妈在花园里种了很多___豆。
zh: 妈妈在花园里种了很多土豆。
py: mā ma zài huā yuán lǐ zhòng le hěn duō tǔ dòu
en: Mum planted a lot of potatoes in the garden.
why: Potatoes grow in the ground, so 土豆 takes 土 tǔ (earth), with the wide line at the bottom. 士 has the long line on top and is in 护士; 士豆 means nothing.

q: 我们坐汽___去机场。
zh: 我们坐汽车去机场。
py: wǒ men zuò qì chē qù jī chǎng
en: We take a car to the airport.
why: A car is 汽车: 车 chē has no feet and a line at the bottom. 东 and 乐 have two little feet; 汽东 and 汽乐 are not vehicles.

q: 这个电影院的___口在左边。
zh: 这个电影院的入口在左边。
py: zhè ge diàn yǐng yuàn de rù kǒu zài zuǒ biān
en: The entrance of this cinema is on the left.
why: An entrance is a mouth you walk into: 入口, with 入 rù (enter), whose long stroke is on the right. 人口 means 'population', and 八口 is nonsense; the cue 'entrance' fixes 入.

q: 我想___己做一个蛋糕送给朋友。
zh: 我想自己做一个蛋糕送给朋友。
py: wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ zuò yī ge dàn gāo sòng gěi péng you
en: I want to make a cake myself to give to my friend.
why: 自己 'oneself' begins with 自 zì: 目 (eye) with a dot on top, pointing to your own nose. 目己 and 白己 are not words.

q: 她的眼___又大又亮，像妈妈一样。
zh: 她的眼睛又大又亮，像妈妈一样。
py: tā de yǎn jing yòu dà yòu liàng xiàng mā ma yī yàng
en: Her eyes are big and bright, just like her mother's.
why: Eyes take the eye radical 目: 眼睛. 晴 has the sun 日 and is weather; 精 has rice 米 and is in 精彩. Eyes (目) can see; the sun (日) only shines.

s: 屋子里很热，我们到处面坐一会儿吧。
s_py: wū zi lǐ hěn rè wǒ men dào chù miàn zuò yī huì r ba
zh: 屋子里很热，我们到外面坐一会儿吧。
py: wū zi lǐ hěn rè wǒ men dào wài miàn zuò yī huì r ba
en: It's hot in the room; let's sit outside for a while.
why: Wrong: 'outside' is 外面, with 夕 on the left. 处 chù, with 夂, belongs in 好处 and 到处; 到处面 is not a word.

q: 今天的雨下得___大了，我们别出门了。
zh: 今天的雨下得太大了，我们别出门了。
py: jīn tiān de yǔ xià de tài dà le wǒ men bié chū mén le
en: The rain is much too heavy today; let's not go out.
why: 'Too heavy' is 太大了, with 太 tài: 大 plus a dot below. Without the dot (下得大大了) the sentence loses 'too'. 天 has a line on top, 犬 a dot at the upper right; neither fits.

s: 天气很热，我想渴一杯冰水。
s_py: tiān qì hěn rè wǒ xiǎng kě yī bēi bīng shuǐ
zh: 天气很热，我想喝一杯冰水。
py: tiān qì hěn rè wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi bīng shuǐ
en: It's hot; I'd like a glass of iced water.
why: Wrong: to drink is 喝 hē, with a mouth 口. 渴 kě is 'thirsty' and cannot take 一杯冰水 as an object. A mouth drinks; water radical = thirst.

q: ___然你累了，就早点休息吧。
zh: 既然你累了，就早点休息吧。
py: jì rán nǐ lèi le jiù zǎo diǎn xiū xi ba
en: Since you're tired, get some rest early.
why: 既然 'since' has 既 jì, whose right side 旡 is a person turned away from the meal, already done. 即 jí (right side 卩) is in 立即 and 即使, and 即然 is not a word.

s: 电影己经开始了，我们快进去吧。
s_py: diàn yǐng jǐ jīng kāi shǐ le wǒ men kuài jìn qù ba
zh: 电影已经开始了，我们快进去吧。
py: diàn yǐng yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le wǒ men kuài jìn qù ba
en: The film has already started; let's hurry in.
why: 己经 is wrong: 'already' is 已经, with 已 half closed. 己 is fully open and means 'self' (自己). Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half.

q: 爸爸每天早上看新___。
zh: 爸爸每天早上看新闻。
py: bà ba měi tiān zǎo shang kàn xīn wén
en: Dad watches the news every morning.
why: News is 新闻: 闻 wén has an ear 耳, as news is what you hear. 新问 and 新间 are not words. An ear at the door hears the news.

s: 我们都很爱听老歌。
s_py: wǒ men dōu hěn ài tīng lǎo gē
zh: 我们都很爱听老歌。
py: wǒ men dōu hěn ài tīng lǎo gē
en: We all love listening to old songs.
why: Correct. 爱 ài (love) has 友 at the bottom; 受 is only 又. Here 'love to listen' fits 爱, and 们 correctly has 亻 for a group of people.

q: 他在门口摆了一张小桌子，___自己做的蛋糕。
zh: 他在门口摆了一张小桌子，卖自己做的蛋糕。
py: tā zài mén kǒu bǎi le yī zhāng xiǎo zhuō zi mài zì jǐ zuò de dàn gāo
en: He set up a small table at the door to sell cakes he made himself.
why: Someone who sets up a table and offers cakes he made is selling: 卖 mài, with the extra 十 on top. 买 (buy) would not fit cakes made by himself. More on top, more to sell.

q: 我的手机不见了，我在到处___。
zh: 我的手机不见了，我在到处找。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī bú jiàn le wǒ zài dào chù zhǎo
en: My phone is missing; I'm looking for it everywhere.
why: 'Look for' is 找 zhǎo, a hand 扌 with a short stroke, matching 到处找. 我 wǒ has an extra slant on top and means 'I', so 到处我 makes no sense.

q: 这个城市里，旅行社之间的___争很大。
zh: 这个城市里，旅行社之间的竞争很大。
py: zhè ge chéng shì lǐ lǚ xíng shè zhī jiān de jìng zhēng hěn dà
en: Competition between travel agencies in this city is intense.
why: 竞争 'compete' has 竞: 立 over 兄, two brothers racing. 竟 (音 over 儿) is in 竟然, and 竟争 is not a word.

q: 听说他不来了，我心里很难___。
zh: 听说他不来了，我心里很难受。
py: tīng shuō tā bù lái le wǒ xīn lǐ hěn nán shòu
en: I heard he is not coming; I feel really upset.
why: 难受 'feel bad, upset' ends in 受 shòu, whose bottom is just 又. 爱 ài has 友 at the bottom and means love; 难爱 is not a word. 爱 has a friend underneath, so it has more.

s: 他们长得很像，我差点认错了。
s_py: tā men zhǎng de hěn xiàng wǒ chà diǎn rèn cuò le
zh: 他们长得很像，我差点认错了。
py: tā men zhǎng de hěn xiàng wǒ chà diǎn rèn cuò le
en: They look so alike that I almost mixed them up.
why: Correct. 像 xiàng, 'resemble', has the person radical 亻. 象 is the elephant: 长得很象 would be the typo.

q: 这个周末你有时___和我们去旅行吗？
zh: 这个周末你有时间和我们去旅行吗？
py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yǒu shí jiān hé wǒ men qù lǚ xíng ma
en: Do you have time this weekend to go travelling with us?
why: 时间 'time' has 日 inside the door: sunlight through a gap. 时问 and 时闻 are not words. Time and sun go together.

q: 你的钢琴弹得真___害！
zh: 你的钢琴弹得真厉害！
py: nǐ de gāng qín tán de zhēn lì hai
en: You play the piano really well!
why: 厉害 'impressive, fierce' is written 厉 with 万 inside 厂. 历 has 力 inside 厂 and gives 历史, so 历害 is the typo; the 万 'ten thousand' is the fierce one.

q: 今天天空是___色的，一朵云也没有。
zh: 今天天空是蓝色的，一朵云也没有。
py: jīn tiān tiān kōng shì lán sè de yī duǒ yún yě méi yǒu
en: The sky is blue today, without a single cloud.
why: Blue is 蓝 lán, with grass 艹, from a plant dye. 篮 has bamboo and is a basket; 篮色 is not a colour. Plants give blue; bamboo makes baskets.
